title: Earthy Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with earthy and korean ingredients. Perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of zenith in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of beans and cook until they start to soften.
Add 2 cups of earth and cook for 5 minutes.
Add 1 packet of korean stew and 4 cups of vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
